observations.behavior: Adds a new utility function getExceptionRelease that normalizes the singular $exception_release property from incoming events into the UI's ErrorTrackingRelease shape.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog users correctly display and filter exception-associated release information when Cymbal sends this specific event-level release snapshot.

observations.behavior: Removes an explicit binding to releasePreviewLogic in ExceptionCard.tsx, removing its selector dependency on frames and stackFrameRecords for displaying a single release. This is done after P1.F7 removes the entire releasePreviewLogic component implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: The removal of the dedicated release preview logic suggests the change may have been made while retaining backward compatibility or preparing for future changes; however, no replacement behavior is shown, so it does not demonstrate added capability.

observations.behavior: Changes taxonomy definitions across frontend JSON and Python backend to recognize the singular $exception_release instead of plural releases, including updated descriptions and labels.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates metadata used by filters and dashboards, potentially allowing users to query or visualize the association between exceptions and their associated release more accurately if downstream consumers adopt the new format.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks are recorded despite multiple relevant ones. No tests show end-to-end UI rendering with the normalized release property. The removed releasePreviewLogic has no replacement implementation visible, leaving potential loss of functionality unverified. Tier 3 requires broader systemic benefit and demonstrated adoption or risk reduction, neither of which is established.

review.limitations: Only three hunks are recorded despite multiple relevant ones. No tests show end-to-end UI rendering with the normalized release property. The removed releasePreviewLogic has no replacement implementation visible, leaving potential loss of functionality unverified. Tier 3 requires broader systemic benefit and demonstrated adoption or risk reduction, neither of which is established.
review.reason: Adds a substantive bounded improvement: normalizes incoming event-level exception release data into PostHog's internal representation and updates taxonomy. Tests cover normalization and edge cases. However, no broader systemic benefit or critical-path dependency is demonstrated, and one component (releasePreview) was removed without an equivalent replacement, preventing tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Could help display and filter exception-associated release information for customers using Cymbal-compatible error tracking; relevance depends on whether other parts of PostHog consume this shape.
review.uncertainty: The removal of P1.F7 and its usage in P1.F8 could indicate either intentional simplification or incomplete migration; without further context we cannot establish that overall capability is preserved or improved.
